newsitem.title: USA: DeVry says 1.8 mln shares offered.
newsitem.headline: DeVry says 1.8 mln shares offered.

text.p: DeVry Inc on Thursday said 1.8 million shares of the company's common stock were offered at $21 per share.
Of the total, 1.2 million are being sold by DeVry and 560,000 by officers and directors. One of the selling stockholders also has granted the underwriters an option to buy 264,000 additional shares.
DeVry, which operates an international higher-education system, intends to use most of the $23.6 million in estimated net proceeds to repay debt under its revolving line of credit.
Smith Barney Inc, ABN AMRO Chicago Corp, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Credit Suisse First Boston Corp managed the offering.
